mapper.select: SELECT FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( risk_level = 'CRITICAL' OR alert_status = 'CRITICAL' OR current_value >= threshold_value ) ORDER BY risk_level DESC, current_value DESC
SELECT FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' AND next_execution_time IS NOT NULL AND next_execution_time < NOW() ORDER BY next_execution_time ASC
SELECT FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND auto_monitoring = 1 AND monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY monitoring_frequency, next_execution_time

SELECT monitoring_status as status, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN auto_monitoring = 1 THEN 1 END) as autoCount, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, AVG(success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(execution_count, 0)) as avgSuccessRate FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY monitoring_status ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT risk_level as level, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as alertCount, AVG(current_value) as avgCurrentValue, AVG(threshold_value) as avgThresholdValue FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT monitoring_frequency as frequency, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, SUM(monitoring_cost) as totalCost FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY monitoring_frequency ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT business_unit as unit, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as alertCount, AVG(current_value) as avgCurrentValue, SUM(monitoring_cost) as totalCost FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY business_unit ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE business_unit = #{businessUnit} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY monitoring_date DESC
SELECT FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_value >= threshold_value ORDER BY (current_value - threshold_value) DESC

SELECT FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_value >= warning_value AND current_value < threshold_value ORDER BY (current_value - warning_value) DESC

SELECT
DATE(monitoring_date) as period
DATE_FORMAT(monitoring_date, '%Y-%u') as period
DATE_FORMAT(monitoring_date, '%Y-%m') as period
CONCAT(YEAR(monitoring_date), '-Q', QUARTER(monitoring_date)) as period
YEAR(monitoring_date) as period
DATE_FORMAT(monitoring_date, '%Y-%m') as period
, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as alertCount, AVG(current_value) as avgCurrentValue, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, AVG(success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(execution_count, 0)) as avgSuccessRate FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT business_unit as unit, monitoring_frequency as frequency, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount, AVG(current_value) as avgCurrentValue, SUM(monitoring_cost) as totalCost FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY business_unit, monitoring_frequency ORDER BY business_unit, monitoring_frequency

mapper.select:
SELECT
monitoring_status as groupKey
business_unit as groupKey
monitoring_frequency as groupKey
risk_level as groupKey
monitoring_status as groupKey
, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN auto_monitoring = 1 THEN 1 END) as autoCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as alertCount, AVG(current_value) as avgCurrentValue, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, AVG(success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(execution_count, 0)) as avgSuccessRate, SUM(monitoring_cost) as totalCost FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY groupKey ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT monitor, COUNT(*) as totalMonitorings, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeMonitorings, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, AVG(success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(execution_count, 0)) as avgSuccessRate, AVG(failure_count) as avgFailureCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as alertCount, AVG(monitoring_cost) as avgCost, SUM(monitoring_cost) as totalCost FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY monitor ORDER BY activeMonitorings DESC, avgSuccessRate DESC

SELECT monitoring_method, COUNT(*) as totalCount, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, AVG(success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(execution_count, 0)) as avgSuccessRate, STDDEV(current_value) as currentValueStdDev, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_indicator IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(monitoring_indicator) > 20 THEN 1 END) as detailedIndicatorCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN threshold_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as hasThresholdCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN warning_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as hasWarningCount, AVG(DATEDIFF(NOW(), last_execution_time)) as avgDaysSinceLastExecution FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY monitoring_method ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT business_unit, monitoring_frequency, COUNT(*) as monitoringCount, AVG(monitoring_cost) as avgCost, MIN(monitoring_cost) as minCost, MAX(monitoring_cost) as maxCost, SUM(monitoring_cost) as totalCost, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, AVG(success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(execution_count, 0)) as avgSuccessRate, (SUM(monitoring_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(execution_count), 0)) as costPerExecution FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitoring_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND monitoring_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY business_unit, monitoring_frequency ORDER BY totalCost DESC

SELECT monitoring_id, monitoring_no, risk_level, monitoring_status, alert_status, current_value, threshold_value, warning_value, last_execution_time, next_execution_time, CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'INACTIVE' THEN 'INACTIVE_MONITORING' WHEN current_value >= threshold_value THEN 'THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED' WHEN current_value >= warning_value THEN 'WARNING_LEVEL' WHEN next_execution_time IS NOT NULL AND next_execution_time < NOW() THEN 'OVERDUE_EXECUTION' WHEN failure_count > success_count THEN 'HIGH_FAILURE_RATE' WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 'CRITICAL_RISK' ELSE 'NORMAL' END as alertType FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
AND (
monitoring_status = 'INACTIVE'
current_value >= threshold_value
current_value >= warning_value AND current_value < threshold_value
next_execution_time IS NOT NULL AND next_execution_time < NOW()
failure_count > success_count
risk_level = 'CRITICAL'
)
ORDER BY CASE alertType WHEN 'THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED' THEN 1 WHEN 'CRITICAL_RISK' THEN 2 WHEN 'WARNING_LEVEL' THEN 3 WHEN 'OVERDUE_EXECUTION' THEN 4 WHEN 'HIGH_FAILURE_RATE' THEN 5 WHEN 'INACTIVE_MONITORING' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END, current_value DESC

SELECT rm.*, rt.risk_type_name, rt.risk_category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE risk_type_id = rm.risk_type_id) as assessmentCount FROM gt_risk_monitoring rm LEFT JOIN gt_risk_type_definition rt ON rm.risk_type_id = rt.risk_type_id WHERE rm.monitoring_id = #{monitoringId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalMonitorings, COUNT(CASE WHEN monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeMonitorings, COUNT(CASE WHEN auto_monitoring = 1 THEN 1 END) as autoMonitorings, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as alertMonitorings, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalMonitorings, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highMonitorings, AVG(current_value) as avgCurrentValue, AVG(execution_count) as avgExecutionCount, AVG(success_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(execution_count, 0)) as avgSuccessRate, SUM(monitoring_cost) as totalMonitoringCost, COUNT(CASE WHEN next_execution_time IS NULL OR next_execution_time < NOW() THEN 1 END) as overdueMonitorings FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
SELECT operation_type, operation_content, operation_user, operation_time FROM gt_risk_monitoring_history WHERE monitoring_id = #{monitoringId} ORDER BY operation_time DESC

SELECT execution_time, execution_result, current_value, alert_triggered, execution_duration, error_message FROM gt_risk_monitoring_execution WHERE monitoring_id = #{monitoringId} ORDER BY execution_time DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT exception_time, exception_type, exception_message, resolution_status, resolution_time FROM gt_risk_monitoring_exception WHERE monitoring_id = #{monitoringId} ORDER BY exception_time DESC
